response.rationale: C2 captures the most specific and diagnostic feature (bilateral vestibular schwannomas) which is pathognomonic for neurofibromatosis type 2, whereas C1 only captures a meningioma which is less specific. The presence of bilateral vestibular schwannomas is the strongest clue to the underlying syndrome.

rejected.why: Incorrectly labels as NF1 despite bilateral vestibular schwannomas which are characteristic of NF2, not NF1.
Ocular finding (PAMM) is a manifestation but not the underlying diagnosis.
Optic disc swelling is a nonspecific finding and not the most likely diagnosis.
Less specific than C1; the span includes both schwannomas and meningioma, but the label is just meningioma.
Less specific than C2; the label is singular vestibular schwannoma, but the finding is bilateral.
